# Size budget of the static linux-x86_64 binary, checked by scripts/size.sh (CI job "size").
#
# "<owner>/<plugin>/<version>  <max bytes>": what the generator adds to the baseline binary
# (bufbuild/es/v2.17.0); the baseline's own line limits its whole binary. "total  <max bytes>": the
# binary with all generators (UNI_GENERATORS=all, the released binary). Every generator version
# has a line, added with the port: the first measurement + 10%, rounded up to 1 KiB. A new
# generator raises total by what the full binary grows (measure it before and after: shared
# libraries count once there, unlike in the deltas). A budget is raised deliberately, in the
# change that needs it.
